reviews.x: Total disappointment  ugly Colors  good for little girls to play around. One of the nail polish came open  I'm getting my money  back don't even waste yours

reviews.t: It's not always what it looks like!
reviews.x: The colors I received were nice, except they were not the colors I saw in the advertisement! I got like 3 different colors of silver. I was so disappointed when I opened the package!
Opened a box of broken glass and dried nail polish. Just throw in 8 bottles of glass nail polish and  a few packing peanuts and call it good? Not okay.
Very lame, horrible colors!!! None of the ones pictured in either pic. I'm very disappointed.
Just okay. Was disappointed i wasn't able to pick the colors. Ended up with a few I'll never wear, so waste of money.

In your ad you don’t tell us what the colors are, that’s because they are the colors NO ONE ELSE WANTED.. one even had a $1 sticker on it, like you tried to sell it for a dollar and still no one wanted it.. I have about 40 sinful nail polishes that I’m super happy with, but these colors are horrible throw backs.. I couldn’t even give them away..

If i could have given zero stars i would have2 colors, 2 with big confetti in it, 2 that have sparkles and 1 top coat. The ones with the confetti and sparkles slides off nails. I am only keeping because it cant be returned. Wont make this mistake again
Not the colors I wanted, but clients seem to like them.

When I first saw this listing I read through the reviews as one normally does while shopping and was stunned at the number of low review scores complaining about the colors. But the listing clearly says random. So I purchased this as a fun "grab bag" completely understanding that it would be random and I could hate every one, but was hoping to get something exciting. I received my order and got lucky and got a couple blue shades, a copper shimmer, a cream color, and a greenish yellow with some s

The polish is fresh, mid density, unique and trendy. It dries quickly. It has an average life span unless you overcoat it with gel top coat and cure under uv light. There were not a lot of colors but I am so tired of coral and peach, etc.. It is fun to experiment with the aqua metallic, pink disco sheer and I got a silver which I think is top rate on women/teen girls. I layer on my older colors like Birthday Cake, Butter Yellow, Violet or Black or Navy. I did not like these on white.

I ordered 2 packs of 8 (total of 16). When received I got 4 orange, 4 blue, 2 light green, 3 Nicole by OPI purples (Not even sinful color) and 3 dark purplish. I get if you order more than 1 pack you may get duplicate but seems like a little excessive on the duplicates for ordering 2 packs. Would have wanted more diversity in colors... I love Sinful Color and the price I got them for... not happy with color selection/variety I got.

according to the description, these polishes are great for females to do manicures and great for females to have and they make the perfect gift for you mom or sister or wife etc.  WTF sinful colours! whats your deal? are guys and boys not allowed to wear nail polish? i was about to buy a set.... for my son. ive decided to get a better brand for him instead. also decided to never buy polish from a sexist nail polish company again

Recieved quite a few neutral colors like silver. Not as many bright colors. They should stipulate that most are neutral colors instead of putting the picture with all the bright colors. I know it says colors vary, but why mostly neutral ones?  It does last awhile on nails, but easy to pick off and fades slowly.

I love the nail polish it stays put well, but my issue is the pack I’ve ordered this 8 pack once before and loved the colors, I decided to purchase again hoping to get some new colors but instead got two new colors and the same six colors I got last time. Very disappointed but other than that great polish

I received 2 duplicates, so 4 out of 8 bottles were the same color. Additionally, one bottle had dried nail polish on the outside. I’ll literally never wear any of these colors except for the cream colored bottle. Do not waste your money. I’ll stick to picking out sinful colors at Target.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: Sinful colors isn't known for their high quality so I guess people should stop complaining about that. I bought these for my daughter. The colors are fine. Mostly sheer colors of glitter top coats which is perfect for her. The top coat has something in it.. not sure what it is.

I was not satisfied with this order, they sent three of the same color and no variety in the shades as they have it advertised here. Also, the blue shades do not come off and leave your nails stained blue forever. Not a product I would buy again nor that I would recommend.

I’m actually pleasantly surprised. It looks like 5 out of 8 are top coats/glitters, which I wasn’t expecting at all but am actually really excited about.  There is a really good chance I’ll be ordering this again just to see what other surprises I’ll get.

Exactly as described. This brand is a less expensive brand than others, but it is great quality (especially for the price!). I got a good assortment of colors, and they arrived packaged well. I would definitely buy these again.

I had no problems with the product, came early and packaged nicely. The only reason I am giving it 4 stars because I had 2 colors repeat. This is the second time it happened. I was hoping for 8 different variety of colors.

Color selection was terrible, 3 metalic 3 with glitte, 1 clear and a couple really dark. I expected a more random color palette and thought for the low cost I would at least like 2-3 of them. Very disappointed
Okay... not really impressed. Blue was split in the packaging and I got of the exact same color.. I guess which would normally be okay but if it wasnt the color I'd be wearing the least.

reviews.t: These aren’t gel, like the written description says!
reviews.x: Be aware the description says “gel” polish but they are not!  The colors are not even the nice ones on the picture.  They give you random colors, the unpopular ones for sure.
Had to use a special top coat because the nail polish wouldn't dry. But a different type of top coat worked well. The sparkly colors are great and I only needed one coat.
Was not sure if I should buy this by some of the negative reviews. I was expecting to be disappointed BUT IM SO HAPPY! Pretty and festive colors for the holidays!

claims.text: Many reviewers are disappointed that the colors received did not match the advertised pictures or their expectations, often receiving unwanted or neutral shades.
Several reviewers report receiving duplicate colors, especially when ordering multiple packs.
Some reviewers complain about packaging and condition issues, including broken glass, dried polish, and open bottles.
A few reviewers note that the polish does not stay on the nails well, with some shades sliding off.
Some positive reviewers appreciate the polish quality, noting it is fresh, dries quickly, and is fun to experiment with, while acknowledging the random color selection.
